test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five friends X, Y, Z, A, and B are sitting in a circle facing the centre. X is to the immediate left of Y and to the immediate right of Z. B is to the immediate right of A. Who is to the immediate left of A?
solution:
Given: Five friends X, Y, Z, A, and B are sitting in a circle facing the centre.

1) X is to the immediate left of Y and to the immediate right of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8876252ce6f9a9cdb8641f5fcbc19433384429a34754a91e3e1aaf1cda6b4dcf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d89f143765d977e47fbb1a41c339313c2cfb4a652cbcd2304ebe22615557f321.png] 

2) B is to the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38d818226a5436223dfb72cf02d0c2bbb23eac3a0b518f61abaef2025428ed2a.png] 

So, 'Y' is to the immediate left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
